description:
MI USB‑A to USB‑C fast charging cable (120cm) is a 3A Type‑C charger cable built for quick top-ups and steady power—at your desk, bedside, or in the car. Plug it into any standard USB‑A wall charger, power bank, laptop, or car USB port and charge compatible Android phones, tablets, earbuds, Bluetooth speakers, and other USB‑C devices. The 1.2m length gives you breathing room, so you’re not stuck hugging the socket.

It also supports up to 480Mbps data transfer, making it handy for moving photos, music, and files or syncing your phone with a PC. If you need one reliable USB‑C cable that charges fast, transfers data, and survives daily use, this is the grab-and-go essential.
